title: Software modification - Windows SwiftPM parallel priors write

beadTrackingRefs.t: Windows SwiftPM parallel priors write bug

stateResults.summary: The exact Windows Swift Testing policy files were clean; unrelated active i18n and maintainer-configuration work remains outside this slice.
Windows SwiftPM tests now default to one job while preserving explicit caller job counts and the release WMO workaround.
The new debug Vaporize binary injected --jobs 1 without a caller job flag and passed 4 focused Swift Testing tests in 1 suite; request vaporize-test-9D5C7F59-4D35-4F62-B497-88B3E12D1FA4.

notes: This is a direct production Windows build fix; no experiment is required.
The caller can opt back into parallelism by passing --jobs or -j explicitly.
The cold serialized Vaporize graph took 1,081.08 seconds; a higher measured Windows concurrency ceiling is a separate performance optimization.
